system.description: When you **_spend a few days communing with Aratis about a threat facing Stonetop or civilization as a whole_**, roll +WIS: **on a 7+**, Aratis reveals the course of action she would have you take; **on a 10+**, you also hold 2 Sanction. While **_acting on her orders_**, spend 1 Sanction to add +1 to a roll you just made.

success.value: Aratis reveals the course of action she would have you take and hold 2 Sanction.

partial.value: Aratis reveals the course of action she would have you take.
